title: Interlocked dual-drawer transfer with anti-tip safety constraint
context: Industrial tool chests and office filing cabinets employ mechanical anti-tip interlocks that prevent multiple drawers from opening simultaneously, which would shift the center of mass and cause the cabinet to tip over. An autonomous bimanual robot must transfer a white block from the left drawer to the right drawer without violating the interlock: opening the second drawer while the first is open triggers a catastrophic TIP FAULT. The task requires coordinating both arms to retrieve the block, close the initial drawer, and open the destination drawer safely.
instruction: Move the white block from the left drawer to the right drawer, never letting both drawers be open at the same time.
setup: All positions are cm from the midpoint between arm bases (x forward, y left); table top is z = 0. Cabinet: 15.0 x 40.0 x 8.0 cm fixture centered at (36.5, 0.0) with front face at x = 29.0 cm. Two friction-held sliding drawers at y = +12.0 cm (left) and y = -12.0 cm (right), each 13.0 x 11.0 x 6.0 cm inside cavity, 11.0 cm travel toward robot, with 2.0 x 4.5 x 3.0 cm orange front handles. White block (4.0 x 4.0 x 4.0 cm, 50 g, friction 1.5) starts at rear of left drawer. Staging pad (6.0 x 6.0 cm) at cabinet top front-centre (31.0, 0.0). Crossbar at x = 42.0 cm with 2.5 cm indicator lamps: OK (green, +3.5 cm) and TIP (red, -3.5 cm).
scoring: Score: 0.25 when left drawer is opened >= 7.0 cm and the white block is lifted out clear above drawer rim; 0.50 when left drawer is closed again (<= 0.5 cm) while block is held outside or parked on staging pad; 0.75 when right drawer is opened >= 7.0 cm; 1.00 when block rests inside right drawer, both drawers closed (<= 0.5 cm), arms clear, grippers open, and held for 20 control steps (1.0 s at 20 Hz). Zero-gates: both drawers open (> 1.5 cm) simultaneously for >= 0.2 s triggers TIP FAULT, locking score to at most 0.25; block dropped off table sets score to 0.0.
reset_notes: Verify both drawers are fully closed (displacement <= 0.5 cm). Confirm white block rests at the rear of the left drawer floor. Confirm OK indicator lamp is lit green and TIP lamp is unlit red.
fidelity: Dual drawer cabinet fixture with sliding prismatic drawers (0.02 N/m friction hold, 110 mm travel, 10 N s/m damping) and front pull handles. White block is a physical rigid body (0.05 kg, friction 1.5). Indicator lamps (OK green, TIP red) updated dynamically via write_pose. Top staging pad at cabinet top front-centre. Real-world basis: filing cabinet anti-tip interlocks and tool chests where dual-drawer opening creates tip-over hazard.
